**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement contains no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binding Corio:

- **Section 2 (Grant of Rights)** — every licence to Corio is "nonexclusive," i.e., exclusivity language runs only to Commerce One as licensor's benefit; nothing restricts Corio from licensing or hosting competing procurement/e-commerce software.
- **Section 2.9 (New Products)** — permissive only; future products are licensed on terms "as the parties may agree," so no forward purchasing commitment.
- **Section 13 (Shared Resources)** and **Exhibit B (pricing/revenue share)** — fee and resource mechanics only; no minimum-purchase or requirements commitment.
- **Exhibit D** — cooperation efforts are expressly "non-binding" and create no preferred-partner or sole-provider restriction.

Provisions that do favour us (Section 2.4 requiring Commerce One to refer Corio Customers back to Corio; MarketSite revenue share) were deliberately not flagged, consistent with the rule that exclusivity benefiting the customer is acceptable.
